text:
jia: Heads-up — customer asked us to bring up Sierra-20B for Dedicated/private deployment. They want INT8 quant option but FP16 fallback OK. Targets: 95p latency <200ms single-token on A10, regen-quality within 2% on our regen eval, privacy requirements (VPC). Can we triage?

ravi: @jia I can take point on quant experiments. Do we have HF weights + model card? Also need typical sequence length distribution.

sam: Customer is AcmeEdge, commercial contract attached in the ticket. They explicitly want VPC + KMS. Ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/AI-2345 (will upload artifacts there).

emily: Quick bring-up checklist (short):
- convert/check model format (HF -> ONNX/ggml/gguf)
- baseline FP16 throughput/latency smoke on 1 GPU
- quant pipeline: try PTQ -> AWQ/q4 variants, keep accuracy baseline
- run regen + safety + hallucination evals (1000 prompts sample)
- kernel/ops audit (custom ops?) and runtime compatibility
- rollout plan: canary on Dedicated, monitor latency + quality metrics

jia: Uploaded tarball to internal s3: s3://redwood-custs/acme/sierra-20b/weights.tar.gz. Sequence profile: median 512, 95p ~1536, often <2048. I also uploaded a small prompt set: s3://redwood-custs/acme/sierra-20b/sierra_sample_prompts.json

ops-bot: Created ticket AI-2345-quant and assigned to ravi.

ravi: Proposed plan:
1) HF -> GGUF/ONNX conversion using tools/convert.py
2) run baseline FP16 eval with eval-harness (regeneration + safety)
3) try int8 candidates: q8_0, AWQ, q4_0 fallback if regression too large
4) perf smoke on A10s for single-token P95 and mem checks
5) if custom ops detected, create eng-runtime task for kernels
Resource ask: 1x A100-40GB for baseline conversion + eval, 2x A10s for perf. ETA ~5 business days to first report. Moving from P2 -> P1 recommended (customer willing to pay for Dedicated). Any objections?

sam: P1 OK from my side. We'll prep a dedicated pool canary plan and customer comms. Add a rollback to FP16 with batching tweaks if necessary.

emily: A couple of nitpicks: check tokenizer compatibility (BPE vs SentencePiece) — token mismatch can wreck KV cache. Also verify kv-cache shapes in conversion; some vendor exports change order.

jia: Noted. Also saw model uses GELUApprox fused op in the export — @ravi can you list ops after conversion? Might require fallback to slower path or small kernel addition.

ravi: Will list ops and push conversion logs to the ticket. If fused op is unique, we can either remap to existing kernels or add a conversion shim. If op surface too big, we serve FP16 while eng-runtime implements kernel.

emily: Scheduling: 30-min sync Wed 11am PT to review first-run numbers. If int8 regen drop >3% we'll prefer q4_0 or FP16 with batching. Also add an eval gating step in rollout: daily regression check for first 72h.

jia: Great — tagging @sam for customer updates. I'll post the first FP16 baseline logs to AI-2345 once done.

sam: Thanks team. I'll draft the customer message outlining timeline and canary plan. :thumbsup:
